virals_narrative: Codie Sanchez dominated again: her capitalism one-liner reached 166.8K, 'You win in business by being ok with people...' 69.4K and her Guillermo Rauch AI list 53.9K. Arvid Kahl's Anthropic API-graph post reached 54.6K. Square's holiday shop-local bitcoin-back post hit 22.5K and Shopify's Shop Pay on Muse post 14.8K. Tony Dinh peaked at 4.0K; Pat Walls posted no originals. No niche vendor post cleared 5K on a quiet Thanksgiving morning; artist alley table costs and Black Friday / Small Business Saturday market announcements were the main vendor topics. Competitors HipopMarkets, BoothKeeper and BuildersBenchRe posted nothing in the window.
